task: Permit only validated Fresh Install Office acceptance preview on the exact review branch, preserving production and staging target isolation

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Critical cross-environment secret-routing safeguard: the only accepted exception is a named, explicitly opted-in temporary Office Fresh preview branch with exact database ref. Fail closed for every other target and retain credential/schema verification. Source CI cannot attest signed customer draft behavior.

acceptanceCriteria: Validator allows Fresh Install only if VERCEL_ENV=preview, exact VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF is fix/office-fresh-preview-security-gate-20261019, SHOPERATION_FRESH_ACCEPTANCE is the agreed marker and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL host is exactly istjjkdcvsvilrycqecd.supabase.co.
Staging remains default for all other preview branches and production exclusively targets ewdederyvnwmghlydbno.supabase.co.
Both Fresh and staging previews require the same schema-compatibility runtime probes with properly configured server and public credentials.
Unit tests reject missing flag, other branches, wrong project, production target and absent server credentials without touching any real DB.
invariants: The checker is a pre-build fail-closed check, not an authorization bypass.
The exception applies to exactly one named Git ref plus a designated boolean-like opt-in marker.
No env marker may allow a Fresh project in production or authorize Water-K staging/production cross-routing.
All eight existing runtime schema probes remain executed on the chosen project.
forbiddenStates: A Fresh preview is enabled on all branches merely because an env flag is present.
Any production deployment targets Fresh or staging.
Any staging preview loses its existing accepted behavior.
A missing sensitive key or missing schema can produce a successful real deployment.

failureModes: An accidental branch match allows sibling PR previews to connect to Fresh.
An opt-in marker alone bypasses database host validation.
Production can be tricked into using preview exception because deployment tag is spoofed.
Schema probes are skipped to work around an invalid Fresh secret.
Preview mistakenly inherits a general staging server key when branch key is not set.
A typo in existing staging reference changes the canonical default target.
edgeCases: The exact proof branch has correct Fresh URL and flag (valid).
The exact proof branch is missing the flag (reject).
A sibling UI branch has the same Fresh URL and flag (reject).
The proof branch has staging URL and flag (still validate staging, no crossrouting).
A production deployment has Fresh URL and flag (reject).
Malformed project URL or unrecognized project ref (reject).
Public key or service key missing (reject).
Real Vercel schema probes fail on missing native Postgres17 table/column (reject).

alternatives.summary: Add exact branch-plus-flag Fresh exception to the preexisting validator, retain all schema probes.
alternatives.reason: Preserves owner-established staging/production security boundaries and permits one auditable controlled proof deployment.

alternatives.summary: Run Next.js build without the validator or bypass the database schema probes.
alternatives.reason: Would permit wrong-target deployments, mismatched service credentials and missing runtime tables without detection.

alternatives.summary: Allow all Vercel Preview branches to target Fresh Install when the public URL is valid.
alternatives.reason: Would expose the shared Fresh user data to unrelated development previews and bypass existing isolation policy.

specialistReviews.finding: A generic environment exception could leak customer data or let production connect to nonproduction Supabase.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require exact deployment type, pinned project hostname, exact proof ref and explicit Fresh acceptance flag; retain all fail-closed probes.

specialistReviews.finding: The global Vercel build skip currently allows only main and a broad edit could re-enable costly auto builds.
specialistReviews.resolution: Do not change the global skip step in source; for one-time proof allow exact target temporarily then restore before acceptance.

specialistReviews.finding: Skipping runtime schema probing would hide deployment database mismatch.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep all 8 zero-row PostgREST schema probes and reject missing server key.

specialistReviews.finding: Fresh database already contains installed support default migration; preview must never reapply it or seed mailbox records.
specialistReviews.resolution: Only deploy the application code to Preview; read-only and authenticated draft evidence happen later under test author account.

challenge.scenario: Office proof branch Fresh target with correct marker and server credentials.
challenge.finding: Old validator blocks every nonstaging Preview.
challenge.resolution: Allow exact branch and pinned project ID after full probes.

challenge.scenario: An unrelated feature PR uses the same Fresh URL and marker.
challenge.finding: Generic flag would leak shared Fresh data across unreviewed branches.
challenge.resolution: Reject any Git ref other than the exact proof branch.

challenge.scenario: Correct branch has no Fresh acceptance marker.
challenge.finding: Mistaken env config might accidentally trigger Fresh acceptance.

challenge.scenario: Production uses Fresh URL plus proof marker.
challenge.finding: A loosely scoped exception would redirect prod secrets.
challenge.resolution: Production condition remains first with exact production ref only.

challenge.scenario: The proof branch requests staging instead of Fresh.
challenge.finding: Proof identity alone might create an invisible second allowed target.
challenge.resolution: Evaluate regular staging preview branch case and preserve scope checks.

challenge.scenario: Fresh public URL is correct but server secret belongs to staging.
challenge.finding: PostgREST zero-row schema probe returns unauthorized or missing relations.
challenge.resolution: Do not skip schema probes; fail build and require correct Fresh secret.

challenge.scenario: Fresh secret is present but new runtime DB is missing required columns.
challenge.finding: A build-only allow rule would deploy a runtime-crashing application.
challenge.resolution: Preserve full eight-probe schema compatibility preflight.

challenge.scenario: A scheduled later branch build tries to run automatically.
challenge.finding: Costs could rise or privacy degrade if the global build gate remains open.
challenge.resolution: Restore global main-only ignored-build rule immediately after explicitly triggering proof deployment.

proofPlan: Plan Before Code exact base and bounded high-risk environment-secret-contract file edit.
Vitest subprocess positive and negative tests with NODE_ENV=test, no external database networking or secret exposure.
Run CI quality tests, TypeScript, source build and Completion Truth/Lifecycle proof on exact branch commit.
Trigger a single Vercel preview build under branch-only temporary ignored-build permission; restore global skip immediately and read Vercel schema-probe logs before any authenticated user action.
operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The Office proof branch uses a real Fresh Install public URL and owner-configured branch-only server key, but the old Vercel runtime schema preflight hard-codes staging for all preview builds. An auditable narrowly scoped one-branch Fresh acceptance route is required without weakening production/staging target isolation or the schema probes.
observableOutcomes: Preview build for fix/office-fresh-preview-security-gate-20261019 with deliberate SHOPERATION_FRESH_ACCEPTANCE marker can use Fresh Install ref istjjkdcvsvilrycqecd after runtime schema probes validate its signed server credentials.
Every other preview branch remains restricted to canonical staging rfuvzgumbardvbvqjxdq and production remains restricted to ewdederyvnwmghlydbno.
Preview is blocked on missing or incorrect acceptance marker, wrong branch, missing server key, incompatible schema or misrouted production URL.
unresolvedRisks: Vercel sensitive secret cannot be read back; postbuild schema preflight and authenticated route acceptance must independently prove owner-configured credential belongs to Fresh.
The Fresh preview does not prove a user's session, Pro entitlement, owner-deny mutation or real draft save without a dedicated signed test.
Future CI on unrelated branches does not authorize auto-builds; global ignored-build step was returned to main-only and preview must be enabled one time.

in: Change the existing deploy environment validator only to allow exactly one explicit Fresh Install Office proof-branch preview while preserving all runtime schema probes.
Add positive and negative subprocess regression cases for branch identity, opt-in flag, project pinning, production and staging isolation.
out: No new hidden deployed environment variable values or use of staging secret against another target.
No change to permanent global Vercel ignored-build rule, Supabase project lifecycle or other production tenant.
No changed customer email RPC, Office mailbox delivery or SQL source identity.

requirements.requirement: Allow only a proven Office Fresh Install branch with explicit acceptance marker, fail-closed credentials and all original production/staging/schema checks.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No ordinary preview or production branch can cross-route to Fresh, and no build without valid runtime credentials/schema is accepted.
